headline: Nitto ATP Finals Day 5: Zverev faces Fils while Shelton meets Jodar for final McEnroe semifinal spot
whyCareReason: Alexander Zverev looks to cap a perfect 3-0 group stage against Arthur Fils, while Ben Shelton battles Rafael Jodar with the second semifinal ticket on the line.
teaser: Carlos Alcaraz is safely through to the semifinals after dismissing Daniil Medvedev 6-2, 6-4 on Wednesday. On Thursday, John McEnroe Group action concludes in Turin as Ben Shelton and Arthur Fils fight for qualification.
story:
The 2026 Nitto ATP Finals in Turin reached a fever pitch on Thursday, 19 November, as the John McEnroe Group takes center stage for its decisive final round-robin matches at Inalpi Arena.

World No. 1 Alexander Zverev has already clinched his spot in Saturday's semifinals with an unblemished 2-0 record, highlighted by Tuesday's clinical 6-2, 7-6 (4) victory over Ben Shelton. Tonight at 8:30 p.m. CET, the German superstar meets France's Arthur Fils (1-1), who fought back from a set down to defeat Spanish debutant Rafael Jodar 4-6, 6-2, 6-2 on Tuesday to keep his tournament alive.

Earlier in the afternoon at 2:00 p.m. CET, American powerhouse Ben Shelton (1-1) faces Jodar (0-2). A straight-sets victory for Shelton puts immense pressure on Fils, creating a dramatic qualification calculus that will determine who joins Zverev from the group.

In Wednesday's Ivan Lendl Group action, Carlos Alcaraz delivered a masterclass, dismissing Daniil Medvedev 6-2, 6-4 in 72 minutes without facing a single break point to advance to the semifinals at 2-0, while Frances Tiafoe defeated Flavio Cobolli in three sets.
stakes: Zverev seeks to top the group at 3-0; Shelton and Fils are tied at 1-1 battling for the group's second semifinal berth.
rivalryAngle: Fils and Shelton are locked in a dead heat for the final qualifying spot, with each needing a superior set percentage to advance to the final four.
funFacts: Alexander Zverev has won 20 of his last 22 sets played at the Inalpi Arena across three tournament appearances.
Carlos Alcaraz has dropped only 10 total games across his first two round-robin matches in Turin.
Ben Shelton has fired 29 aces combined through his opening two matches against Fils and Zverev.
